RB-PUB-temp.question: What is the operating temperature range of NE301 edge camera

sources.title: NE301 Edge AI Camera Outdoor Deploying Guide:  Power, Connectivity, and Fleet Management
Refrigerator Shelf Monitoring with Edge AI Cameras
Camthink NeoEyes NE301 Guide: Edge AI Camera with STM32N6

RB-PUB-temp.answer:
**Operating Temperature Range**

The NE301 operates from **−20°C to +50°C**, rated for extreme outdoor environments including refrigerated cabinets (2°C–8°C) and freezers (−18°C). [1][2][3][4]

**Low-Temperature Note**

At −20°C, effective alkaline AA battery capacity drops approximately 25–35% versus room temperature; lithium AA cells retain ~85–90% capacity at −20°C and are recommended for cold-climate deployments. [3]
